type.description: one word: build, fix, research, ops, writing, planning or mixed

focus.description: what this session was about and did, one sentence in English, naming the project

work.description: up to 4 short items: what was built, fixed or decided

ended.description: how the session ended: done, blocked on what, or left mid-way, one sentence

open.description: up to 3 things left open at the end, or an empty list

repos.description: the repositories or projects it touched

th.description: two sentences in Thai, English tech words left in English
